description: Draft a client contract (service agreement, statement of work or master services agreement) or a simpler proposal in the user's TempoRevenue account from a short brief: client, scope, timeline and budget. Use it when a freelancer, consultant or agency wants a contract, agreement, SOW, MSA, quote or proposal for client work. For a statement of work under a signed master services agreement, pass its id from list_contracts. The model extracts the scope; code calculates the price (a stated price, or estimated hours times the user's rate, when set). Returns an editor link for review. Does not publish, send, collect payment or give legal advice. Publishing a contract for signature uses one credit in the web app.

contract_type.description: service_agreement (default): a contract for one project. statement_of_work: one project, usually under a master services agreement. master_services_agreement: framework terms for ongoing work with the same client. proposal: a simpler priced proposal without formal contract clauses. Pick the one the user asked for.

deal_description.description: Brief description of the client's request. Do not send the full chat history.

language.description: Language of the contract. If omitted, it follows the language of the description.

master_agreement_id.description: Only for a statement of work: id of the user's signed master services agreement (from list_contracts) that this SOW falls under. The SOW then incorporates it and the MSA prevails. Omit for a standalone document.
